bench.reportNote: LI41 is a replication of LI38 on fresh seeds (41400 to 41411): same instrument, model, size, density, rounds and limits; only the seeds and the cap ([US$ redacted]) differ. H-LI123 to H-LI126 are LI38's H-LI115 to H-LI118 unchanged. Report LI38 and LI41 side by side, and the pooled 24 cases as descriptive only. Required by the Research Leader at approval (2026-11-22): (1) With 12 cases, H-LI123 is supported only if stigwait is better in at least 10 (exact sign test: 10 to 2 gives p = 0.039, 9 to 3 gives p = 0.146). Say this explicitly; a 9 to 3 split is not a partial replication. (2) If the runner's cap check stopped a wave, the run is incomplete: no verdicts, no cases cut, and a resume needs the owner's approval through the Research Leader. (3) LI41 closes only the replication half of CONVENTIONS rule 5 (fresh seeds). No sentence may suggest transfer across model families: one family (Haiku 5.5) was tested.
